per_finding_fixes.H1_incremental_alpha: Family API contract gains the REQUIRED arm 'benchmark_treatment' (runner docstring + enforcement). On a SCORED anchor cell the runner calls run_arm('benchmark_treatment'), validates it under the same fail-closed rules, session-gates, books it through the SAME V3 kernel dual book, and records incremental_alpha = anchor financing-adjusted expectancy - benchmark expectancy (10dp); the value is ALWAYS present on a scored anchor record (BENCHMARK_BOOK_EMPTY fails closed if the benchmark book is empty), so INCREMENTAL_ALPHA_NOT_POSITIVE can no longer be dead code. Dry-run leaves None (no outcome leak). The benchmark arm is refused as a cell of its own (BENCHMARK_TREATMENT_IS_NOT_A_SCORED_CELL); a family without the arm fails the scored anchor cell via its own unknown-arm refusal. Non-anchor scored cells keep the meta pass-through (normally None).
per_finding_fixes.H2_usd_drift: The frozen D1 equal-weight USD index is now computed INSIDE the runner from the authorized H1 snapshot only (new usd_index_daily_returns / usd_index_from_data_paths; day step = 16:00-NY bar -> next existing 16:00-NY bar; XXX/USD contributes -pair return, USD/XXX +pair return; equal-weight mean per day keyed by the later bar's UTC date). Source keys understood, in order: usd_index_h1_dir, price_h1_dir (family1), h1_dir (family2); a present-but-broken source raises BLOCKED_DATA. meta.usd_index_daily_returns is NO LONGER consulted (family2 keeps passing None). Per scored arm the correlation of daily arm PnL vs the index feeds the unchanged usd_corr_abs_ceiling 0.3 gate over the >= 60-common-day window. Fail-closed: a SCORED run with booked trades and no price source raises USD_INDEX_SOURCE_MISSING; the record carries usd_index_source + usd_index_pairs for audit.
per_finding_fixes.H3_dry_run_hygiene: compute_cell now applies dry_run_sanitized() to EVERY dummy dry-run record AFTER internal computation: gross_price_pnl_usd, price_only_pnl_usd, financing_adjustment_usd, financing_adjusted_pnl_usd, base, base_price_only, every folds entry, the stress sub-record at every tier (total_pnl/expectancy/gross_positive -> 0.0, pf -> None, cost delta -> 0.0 -- the exact leak the auditor measured on family2:causal_negative_control), break_even_cost_bps -> None, mdd_usd -> 0.0, fold_positive_share -> 0.0, pair_concentration -> {}, drop_one_expectancy -> 0.0, dropout_scenarios -> expectancy/survived None, incremental_alpha -> None, benchmark_treatment -> None, usd_drift_diag -> corr None/evaluated False. Counts (n_decisions, n_trades_kept, weekend_gate_dropped, purged_trades, folds_declared, per-metrics trades, delay_stress counts) and scored=false/real_pnl=false/published=false survive.
per_finding_fixes.M1_fold_drop_survival: New dropout_scenarios() extends the dropout suite with ONE drop-one-BEST-fold scenario (the fold with the highest expectancy among folds holding trades; its trades removed, after-cost expectancy of the reduced book recomputed) alongside the frozen 7 drop-one-PAIR exclusions; per-scenario {scenario, expectancy, survived} booleans are recorded in record['dropout_scenarios']. A scenario survives iff the reduced-book expectancy > 0; an unevaluable fold scenario is survived=False (fail closed). stage_a_gates counts survivals across the whole suite against the UNCHANGED frozen DROPOUT_SURVIVAL_MIN = 5; the gate reason is renamed DROP_ONE_PAIR_SURVIVAL_INSUFFICIENT -> DROPOUT_SURVIVAL_INSUFFICIENT. DEVIATION NOTE: the lane order said '7 scenarios = 6 drop-one-pair + 1 drop-one-best-fold'; the frozen universe has SEVEN pairs, so dropping one pair scenario would have been arbitrary selection -- the suite is the 7 pair exclusions PLUS the fold scenario (8 total) with the frozen minimum 5 unchanged, which preserves every frozen behavior and only ADDS the fold test.
